name: journal-fit-engine
title_zh: 投稿前先查期刊底线，再谈匹配度的选刊引擎
tagline_zh: 别等拒稿信才知期刊早换了口味。逐条核对范围、类型、方法、受众、贡献与撤稿风险，输出带证据的短名单和投稿策略。
tagline_en: Don't learn a journal's new taste from a rejection. Checks scope, type, methods, audience, contribution &.
desc_en: Analyze manuscript–journal fit across disciplines using current scope, article type, methodology, audience, contribution, journal evidence, practical submission constraints, and publication-integrity checks to produce evidence-backed venue shortlists and submission strategies.
why_zh: 它把「匹配」拆成可核验的七层证据链，每条结论都指向期刊官网或原文，不是拍脑袋打分。
why_en: It breaks 'fit' into seven checkable evidence layers, each tied to the journal's own site or papers—a due-diligence pass, not a.
limit_zh: 只评估已存在期刊，不收录新刊或停刊；不代查影响因子与审稿周期；结论基于你提供的摘要与期刊公开信息。
limit_en: Covers existing journals only; no IF or turnaround data; relies on your abstract & public journal info; preprints or dual-submission must be.
title_en: Journal fit checker: scope, ethics & strategy before you.
